value: Each student may participate on only one team and submit one concept per competition year.
Concepts must not have generated more than $100,000 in total revenue prior to the submission deadline.
Submissions must avoid listing or disclosing school names unless the school is a critical element of the concept.
The competition team may disqualify participants who violate rules or the spirit of the competition.
